task.question: In the group stage match between DR Congo and Uzbekistan on June 27, 2026, advancing to the World Cup knockout phase was the _____ time DR Congo had achieved this milestone.
task.evidence: Additional goals by Fiston Mayele and Yoane Wissa secured DR Congo's spot in the knockout phase for the first time ever.

answer:
Perfect! I now have the information I need. According to the search results:
